content.Summary: The guideline discusses chronic coronary disease, focusing on glucose-lowering therapies, weight management, and cardiovascular outcomes. It highlights multiple studies and trials evaluating the effects of different medications and lifestyle changes on cardiovascular health, particularly among patients with diabetes or obesity.
